newsitem.title: USA: IES sees Iowa power plant on line Thursday.
newsitem.headline: IES sees Iowa power plant on line Thursday.

text.p: IES Utilities said Monday it expects its 538 MW Duane Arnold nuclear power plant to be back on line Thursday and operating at full power by the weekend.
The unit, in Palo, Iowa, was shut Saturday to correct a leak in a water line in the plant's heat recovery system.
"We expect to start up on Wednesday, synch to the grid on Thursday, and reach 100 percent on the weekend," company spokesman Tom Petersen said.
IES has a 70 percent interest in the Duane Arnold plant, with two Iowa power cooperatives holding the rest.
The Duane Arnold facility accounted for about 31 percent of IES's power generation in 1995.
Petersen said it is possible IES may have to purchase additional electricity as a result of the unexpected outage.

"Purchased power makes up about 25 percent of our total portfolio anyway, so there may have to be an adjustment in that, but due to the short nature of the outage we don't expect any long-term impact," he said.
